gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2018, Syndicate 2623 released prior year reserves of $110.0m, representing a 3.25% release of opening gross claims outstanding. This overall release was driven by increased reserve releases in the specialty lines division as the post-recession portfolio matured and included amounts from the cyber portfolio. However, this was partially offset by lower releases in short-tail classes and a strengthening of $48.0m in property reserves due to higher attritional claims and strengthening on 2017 catastrophe estimates. A commutation agreement with syndicate 6050 on 2016 and 2017 year of account contracts also occurred.
